analyst_view.overall: Early view: Eldense, coached by Javi Calleja since September, drew 0-0 at Las Palmas on Monday and have scored only 13 goals in 13 games. Girona are eighth under Quique Álvarez but have lost their last two 1-0 without scoring, to Real Sociedad B and Almería. Girona have the better side, but recent form points to a tight game.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.4 goals. I lean lower: Eldense average about a goal a game, Girona have been shut out in their last two, and Girona's away games have averaged just over two goals.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.0 corners. Girona won seven corners against Almería and should have more of the ball here, while Eldense won only one at Las Palmas; together that fits the site's number.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.5 cards. I lean higher: Eldense were booked six times and committed 21 fouls at Las Palmas, Justin Smith already reached five yellows earlier in the season, and Girona picked up five yellows against Almería.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.3 shots. I lean lower: Girona's club data show them averaging 10.6 shots a game and Eldense 9.9, and Eldense managed only six at Las Palmas.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.2 shots on target. I lean lower: Eldense put one shot on target at Las Palmas and Girona three against Almería, and neither attack is in good form.
